subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'work with'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'work with'.**
 
• It means **'To cooperate with someone in order to perform some task, activity, responsibility, etc.' **(किसी कार्य, गतिविधि, जिम्मेदारी आदि को करने के लिए किसी के साथ सहयोग करना)
